name: ns_proofsearch_independent_multishell_cascade
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5DL-5DP showed local and bounded multi-shell residual-tax domination while the projection ratio approaches one from below. The target is now an independent multi-shell cascade generator or a theorem-shaped ceiling, with strict anti-tautology discipline.
description: Focused theorem-search substrate for independent multi-shell Navier-Stokes cascade generators at the residual-tax boundary.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier theorem-search over independently generated multi-shell cascades and residual-defect/profit ledgers.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by generator independence, residual-defect accounting, profit discipline, and theorem boundary sharpness.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The prior deterministic audits found local and bounded multi-shell residual-tax domination near the canonical stationary-Euler packet, with ratios approaching one from below. Reward only an independently generated multi-shell cascade, a theorem-shaped subcritical ceiling, or an exact escrowed conjecture. Penalize phase-fitting, backward-solved residual cancellation, Clay overclaims, metric-kernel substitution, pressure-source-only claims, envelope-only pincer repeats, and tautological definitions of cascade/profit/Defect_n.

dimensions.name: Independent Generator Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the submission define a cascade generator independently of the desired residual/profit result before scoring?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Ledger
dimensions.description: Does it compute or bound projected residual, transfer margin, reset residual, or Defect_n rather than assuming realization?

dimensions.name: Pressure-Profit Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it distinguish pressure source/visibility from signed pressure-strain, recurrence, resupply, or Leray-visible velocity profit?

dimensions.name: Multi-Shell Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it specify shell support, lattice geometry, amplitude/phase law, and divergence-free constraints precisely enough to falsify?

dimensions.name: No-Go Or Positive Strength
dimensions.description: Does it provide a plausible positive construction or a sharp subcritical ceiling theorem with stated scope?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, CAS/Lean-facing object list, exact Fourier falsifier, or decisive reranking?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name the cheapest exact Fourier, symbolic, or residual-defect falsifier?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Independence
dimensions.description: HARD GATE. Reject phase sequences, amplitudes, observables, thresholds, or Defect_n values defined by the desired cancellation or profit conclusion.

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay-level overclaims and state exact finite/asymptotic scope?

criteria.Independent_Generator_Discipline: Full credit requires a predeclared geometric/dynamical generator independent of the scored residual/profit outcome.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Ledger: Full credit requires projected residual/Defect_n accounting sufficient to assess transfer to true NSE behavior.
criteria.Pressure_Profit_Discipline: Full credit requires explicit separation of pressure source from useful pressure-strain, recurrence, resupply, or Leray-visible velocity profit.
criteria.Multi_Shell_Specificity: Full credit requires concrete shell support, lattice recursion, phase/amplitude law, and divergence-free constraints.
criteria.No_Go_Or_Positive_Strength: Full credit requires either a positive independent construction with obligations or a no-go/ceiling theorem with sharp boundary.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a theorem packet, exact Fourier falsifier, symbolic ceiling, or project-reranking.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires naming what would kill the proposal and how to test it cheaply.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Independence: Score ZERO for phase-fitting, backward-solved residual cancellation, defining cascade as profit/residual optimizer, or assuming Defect_n/profit dominance in the antecedent.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject Clay-level overclaims, pressure-gauge artifacts, metric-kernel substitution, envelope-only repeats, and approximate-equals-exact laundering.

success_criteria: An independent multi-shell cascade generator with residual/profit ledger crossing ratio 1 and Defect_n obligations.
A subcritical ceiling theorem explaining the bounded ladder approaching 1 from below for a stated generator class.
A falsifiable multi-shell conjecture with generator class, observable, projected residual, and exact bounded test.
A decisive proof-cost reranking between broader exact Fourier audits, ZTARE theorem search, and abandoning this pressure-profit route.
failure_modes: Choosing phases or amplitudes by solving backward for residual cancellation.
Defining the cascade as whatever maximizes profit/residual ratio.
Assuming Defect_n < 1 or profit dominance in the theorem antecedent.
Claiming pressure source implies pressure profit.
Using broad pincer exponents without explicit packet realization.
Ignoring gauge, Leray projection, or projected residual.
Promoting a near-1 projection ratio to a Clay-level claim.
